Spray Dried Cabbage Powder for Soups, Seasonings and Savory Foods

Tradenest Naturals supplies spray dried cabbage powder for soup, seasoning, snack and ready-meal producers. It is a concentrated vegetable ingredient that brings a mild, savory cabbage note to dry and liquid recipes. Fresh cabbage is spray dried into a fine, stable powder that keeps the natural flavor and pale green-cream color of the vegetable. As a spray dried cabbage powder supplier, we hold every batch to the same written specification.

The Science of Our Spray Drying Process

Our process starts with fresh cabbage that is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. The heads are trimmed, washed and prepared before juicing. The cabbage liquid is then atomized into a chamber of hot air. Each droplet loses its water almost at once. Because drying is so quick, heat exposure stays short. The finished powder keeps its typical aroma and flavor. Since we run drying and packing in-house, we can offer a dependable wholesale spray dried cabbage powder supply for your production plans.

Why Choose Our Spray Dried Cabbage Powder?

Food buyers need ingredients that behave the same way every time. Our spray dried cabbage powder exporter service delivers a powder with good solubility and stable quality in sealed packs. Unlike dried cabbage flakes, the powder blends directly into liquids and dry mixes. It also takes up far less space than fresh vegetables, which cuts storage and freight costs. Whether you want a bulk spray dried cabbage powder supplier India can offer or a long-term global partner, Tradenest Naturals ships worldwide from India. We aim to add real vegetable character to your products in a convenient form.

Technical Specifications and Quality Assurance

Technical detail matters to B2B buyers. Each batch of cabbage powder is checked for moisture and particle size before packing. Every lot carries a batch number for traceability. The standard grade is spray dried, 80-100 mesh, with moisture below 5% and a shelf life of 18-24 months. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. If your application needs a different particle size, share your requirement and our team will tell you what is possible.

Versatile Applications Across Industries

The powder is used across several sectors. Soup and seasoning makers use it for natural vegetable notes. Supplement brands use it in vegetable powder blends. Snack makers add it to savory coatings. Because it is easy to handle and dose, it is also popular with instant sauce and noodle developers. It gives product teams a flexible base for new recipes.

Frequently Asked Questions for Buyers

What is the minimum order quantity for spray dried cabbage powder? The MOQ is 5 Kg. Larger orders get better pricing, and we are happy to supply small lots for first trials or private label testing. What certifications and quality standards apply? Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI registered food business and an IEC registered exporter, and we provide export documentation support. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. What are the packaging and shelf-life options? We pack in bulk bags and stand-up pouches, with OEM and private label packing available. Shelf life is 18-24 months when stored sealed in a cool, dry place. All packing is food-grade and moisture-resistant. What is the lead time and how do I request a sample or quote? Lead time depends on order volume and packing needs. Samples are available on request. To ask for a quote or a sample, contact our sales team through the website.

Your Trusted Partner in Food Innovation

Tradenest Naturals wants to be a supply partner you can plan around. We combine careful sourcing with practical supply experience. This lets us offer a fair spray dried cabbage powder price while keeping quality steady. Explore our wider range of vegetable and fruit powders and build your product line with us.
